title: Steal a car
instruction: Commit to a reachable automobile, follow the street or a clear pedestrian route, intercept slow traffic from in front and wait for it to stop if needed, walk around to the actual driver door, press F once, and remain the driver for two seconds. Prefer parked or stopped cars. Ignore bicycles and motorcycles for this task.
setup: Start on foot outdoors near a reachable road, using the opening New Game alley or a manually staged free-roam save with --reset none. The agent can leave the alley and look for traffic; no car is spawned.
